description: This file defines a custom exception class PostInterestClosingDateException used within the savings portfolio module of the Apache Fineract project, to handle domain rule violations related to posting interest after the closing date.

classes.name: PostInterestClosingDateException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating an error related to posting interest after the closing date within the savings account domain.

methods.name: PostInterestClosingDateException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message indicating that posting interest was attempted after the closing date.

calls: super("error.msg.postInterest.notDone", "Please do a post interest on the closing date")
